issuing_orgs: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
synopsis: The purpose of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Clinical Trials Units (CTUs). CTUs will provide the infrastructure, as well as the scientific and administrative expertise to conduct clinical studies developed by NIH HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Networks to advance research in the prevention and treatment of HIV and HIV-associated diseases. CTUs will participate in multiple clinical research studies, accessing relevant populations most heavily impacted by the HIV/AIDS epidemic and studies of highest priority to NIH.
title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Clinical Trials Units (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
